# Parent tag identity must match the recorded original build006 image before and after build.
FROM kairos-investigation-pytest:build006
USER root
COPY wheels/ /wheels/
COPY requirements.lock /tmp/dependencies.lock
RUN python -m pip --isolated install --disable-pip-version-check --no-cache-dir --no-index --no-deps --require-hashes -r /tmp/dependencies.lock \
    && python -c "import importlib_metadata, zipp; assert importlib_metadata.version('importlib-metadata') == '6.7.0'; assert importlib_metadata.version('zipp') == '3.15.0'" \
    && rm -rf /wheels /tmp/dependencies.lock
USER 10001:10001
WORKDIR /workspace
